# Sexism and Relationship Processes

```{r}
library(readr)
library(metafor)
data <- read_csv("~/Downloads/Effect Sizes_relationships - Sheet1.csv", 
    col_types = cols(Study...3 = col_character(), 
        N_m = col_number(), N_w = col_number(), 
        MenHS_a = col_number(), MenBS_a = col_number(), 
        WomenHS_a = col_number(), WomenBS_a = col_number(), 
        MenHS_p = col_number(), MenBS_p = col_number(), 
        WomenHS_p = col_number(), WomenBS_p = col_number()))


```

## Effect Size Calculations

```{r}
# Calculating fisher z 
men_hsA<- escalc(
  measure = "ZCOR",
  ri = MenHS_a,
  ni = N_m,
  data = data
)

men_bsA<- escalc(
  measure = "ZCOR",
  ri = MenBS_a,
  ni = N_m,
  data = data
)

women_hsA<- escalc(
  measure = "ZCOR",
  ri = WomenHS_a,
  ni = N_w,
  data = data
)

women_bsA<- escalc(
  measure = "ZCOR",
  ri = WomenBS_a,
  ni = N_w,
  data = data
)

data$MenHSa_z<- men_hsA$yi
data$MenHSa_se<- sqrt(men_hsA$vi)

data$MenBSa_z<- men_bsA$yi
data$MenBSa_se<- sqrt(men_bsA$vi)

data$WomenHSa_z<- women_hsA$yi
data$WomenHSa_se<- sqrt(women_hsA$vi)

data$WomenBSa_z<- women_bsA$yi
data$WomenBSa_se<- sqrt(women_bsA$vi)

```


## Satisfaction meta-analytic estimate
```{r}
Pos <- data$DV_re == "Positive Relationship Processes"

model.mhs <- rma(
  yi = data$MenHSa_z[Pos],
  sei = data$MenHSa_se[Pos],
  method = "REML"
)

model.mhs
predict(model.mhs, transf = transf.ztor)

#mbs
model.mbs <- rma(
  yi = data$MenBSa_z,
  sei = data$MenBSa_se,
  subset = (data$DV_re == "Positive Relationship Processes"),
  method = "REML"
)

model.mbs
predict(model.mbs, transf = transf.ztor)

#whs
model.whs <- rma(
  yi = data$WomenHSa_z[Pos],
  sei = data$WomenHSa_se[Pos],
  method = "REML"
)

model.whs
predict(model.whs, transf = transf.ztor)

#wbs
model.wbs <- rma(
  yi = data$WomenBSa_z,
  sei = data$WomenBSa_se,
  subset = (data$DV_re == "Positive Relationship Processes"),
  method = "REML"
)

model.wbs
predict(model.wbs, transf = transf.ztor)
```

## Benevolent Sexism Negative Relationship Outcome Plots

```{r}
pdf(
  "benNeg.pdf",
  width = 11,
  height = 8.5
)
Neg <- data$DV_re == "Negative Relationship Processes"
par(mfrow = c(2,1))
forest(
  model.mbs.2,
  slab = paste0(
    data$Study,
    " (N = ",
    data$N_m,
    ")"
  ),
  transf = transf.ztor,
  xlab = "Correlation (r)",
  main = "Men's Benevolent Sexism and Negative Relationship Processes",
  alim = c(-1, 1)
)

forest(
  model.wbs.2,
  slab = paste0(
    data$Study,
    " (N = ",
    data$N_w,
    ")"
  ),
  transf = transf.ztor,
  xlab = "Correlation (r)",
  main = "Women's Benevolent Sexism and Negative Relationship Processes",
  alim = c(-1, 1)
)
```

# Sexism and Mental Health

```{r}
data.1 <- read_csv("~/Downloads/Effect Sizes_mentalhealth - Sheet1.csv", 
    col_types = cols(Study_num = col_character(), 
        N_m = col_number(), N_w = col_number(), 
        MenHS_a = col_number(), MenBS_a = col_number(), 
        WomenHS_a = col_number(), WomenBS_a = col_number(), 
        MenHS_p = col_number(), MenBS_p = col_number(), 
        WomenHS_p = col_number(), WomenBS_p = col_number()))
```

## Effect size calculation

```{r}
## Effect Size Calculations


# Calculating fisher z 
men_hsA.mh<- escalc(
  measure = "ZCOR",
  ri = MenHS_a,
  ni = N_m,
  data = data.1
)

men_bsA.mh<- escalc(
  measure = "ZCOR",
  ri = MenBS_a,
  ni = N_m,
  data = data.1
)

women_hsA.mh<- escalc(
  measure = "ZCOR",
  ri = WomenHS_a,
  ni = N_w,
  data = data.1
)

women_bsA.mh<- escalc(
  measure = "ZCOR",
  ri = WomenBS_a,
  ni = N_w,
  data = data.1
)

data.1$MenHSa_z.mh<- men_hsA.mh$yi
data.1$MenHSa_se.mh<- sqrt(men_hsA.mh$vi)

data.1$MenBSa_z.mh<- men_bsA.mh$yi
data.1$MenBSa_se.mh<- sqrt(men_bsA.mh$vi)

data.1$WomenHSa_z.mh<- women_hsA.mh$yi
data.1$WomenHSa_se.mh<- sqrt(women_hsA.mh$vi)

data.1$WomenBSa_z.mh<- women_bsA.mh$yi
data.1$WomenBSa_se.mh<- sqrt(women_bsA.mh$vi)

```

# Meta-analytic estimates

```{r}
PMH <- data.1$DV_recoded == "PMH"

#mbs and postive mental health
model.mbs.pmh <- rma(
  yi = data.1$MenBSa_z.mh[PMH],
  sei = data.1$MenBSa_se.mh[PMH],
  method = "REML"
)

model.mbs.pmh
predict(model.mbs.pmh, transf = transf.ztor)

#wbs and positive mental health
model.wbs.pmh <- rma(
  yi = data.1$WomenBSa_z.mh[PMH],
  sei = data.1$WomenBSa_se.mh[PMH],
  method = "REML"
)

model.wbs.pmh
predict(model.wbs.pmh, transf = transf.ztor)


# BS and negative mental health

NMH <- data.1$DV_recoded == "NMH"

#mbs and negative mental health
model.mbs.nmh <- rma(
  yi = data.1$MenBSa_z.mh[NMH],
  sei = data.1$MenBSa_se.mh[NMH],
  method = "REML"
)

model.mbs.nmh
predict(model.mbs.nmh, transf = transf.ztor)

#wbs and negative mental health
model.wbs.nmh <- rma(
  yi = data.1$WomenBSa_z.mh[NMH],
  sei = data.1$WomenBSa_se.mh[NMH],
  method = "REML"
)

model.wbs.nmh
predict(model.wbs.nmh, transf = transf.ztor)
```
## Forest Plots

### Positive Mental Health

```{r}
pdf(
  "benPMHplots.pdf",
  width = 11,
  height = 8.5
)
par(mfrow = c(2,1))

x_limits <- c(-2.5, 2)  
x_ticks  <- seq(-1, 1, by = 0.5)

forest(
  model.mbs.pmh,
  slab = paste0(
    data.1$Study[PMH],
    " (N = ",
    data.1$N_m[PMH],
    ")"
  ),
  transf = transf.ztor,
  xlab = "Correlation (r)",
  main = "Men's Benevolent Sexism and Positive Mental Health",
  xlim = x_limits,
  alim = c(-1, 1),
  at = x_ticks
)

forest(
  model.wbs.pmh,
  slab = paste0(
    data.1$Study[PMH],
    " (N = ",
    data.1$N_w[PMH],
    ")"
  ),
  transf = transf.ztor,
  xlab = "Correlation (r)",
  main = "Women's Benevolent Sexism and Positive Mental Health",
  xlim = x_limits,
  alim = c(-1, 1),
  at = x_ticks
)

dev.off()
```
